put.description:
Adds an idempotent immediate parent-child rule. The same child
type may be allowed beneath multiple parent types, and
self-relations are valid. The rule is enforced when new
assets are reserved. Platform-administrator access is
required.

404.description: Parent or child type not found

409.description: ROOT cannot be used as a child type

delete.description:
Removes the rule for future asset creation. Existing assets
are not moved or invalidated. Platform-administrator access
is required.

404.description: Allowed-child rule not found

put.description:
Updates the human-readable label and description. The
assetType path key is immutable. ROOT cannot be changed.
Platform-administrator access is required.

404.description: Asset type not found

delete.description:
Deletes an unused catalog entry. Deletion is rejected while
the type is used by a workspace asset or any allowed-child
rule. ROOT cannot be deleted. Platform-administrator access
is required.

404.description: Asset type not found

409.description: Type is in use or ROOT was requested

put.description:
Updates the device name, label, and description. The request's
id selects the device. Device type, profile, asset assignment,
gateway flag, and credentials are preserved.

403.description: ADMINISTER product access required

404.description: Device not found in this workspace product

post.description:
Creates a device and assigns it to an active Paapeli asset in
the authorized workspace product. If profileId is omitted,
the product's default device profile is used. For ACCESS_TOKEN
credentials, credentialValue may be omitted and an identifier
is generated. The response intentionally contains Paapeli's
device representation, not an upstream entity payload.

MQTT basic device.value:
{
  "label": "Packaging gateway",
  "type": "gateway",
  "name": "packaging-gateway-01",
  "description": "Gateway for the packaging line",
  "isGateway": true,
  "credentialType": "MQTT_BASIC",
  "credentialValue": "{"clientId":"packaging-gateway-01","userName":"gateway","password":"replace-me"}",
  "assetId": "e75b06a5-a437-467a-b40b-2d31f0746056"
}

400.description: Invalid fields, profile, credentials, or conflicting device name

403.description: ADMINISTER access required or the asset is outside this workspace product

409.description: The target asset is not active

get.description:
Returns the device's current authentication material.
ADMINISTER access is required because the response may expose
an access token, certificate, or password-bearing payload.

403.description: ADMINISTER product access required

404.description: Device not found in this workspace product

put.description:
Replaces the authentication material for a device that belongs
to the authorized workspace product. ADMINISTER access is
required. Credential values are secrets: do not log or persist
the response in an insecure client store.

403.description: ADMINISTER product access required

404.description: Device not found in this workspace product

put.description:
Updates an asset's name, label, and description. Its type and
parent cannot be changed. The system ROOT node is immutable.

403.description: ADMINISTER access required or ROOT was requested

404.description: Asset not found

409.description: Asset is not active or the new name conflicts

delete.description:
Deletes an active non-ROOT asset. The asset must have no child
assets and no assigned devices; callers should remove those
relationships first.

403.description: ADMINISTER access required or ROOT was requested

404.description: Asset not found

409.description: Asset is not active or is not empty

get.description: Lists workspaces in which the authenticated user has an ACTIVE membership.

403.description: An active user account is required

post.description:
Creates an active workspace. The authenticated user becomes
its active OWNER. Product infrastructure is not provisioned
until the workspace subscribes to a product.

403.description: An active user account is required

get.description: Lists the workspace's product subscriptions and their current states.

403.description: The caller cannot read this workspace

post.summary: Subscribe a workspace to a product
post.description:
Provisions the product's backing resources for the workspace
and activates the subscription. Only a role with
SUBSCRIBE_PRODUCT permission may call this endpoint. A failed
subscription can be retried; active, provisioning, and
suspended subscriptions conflict with a new request.

403.description: The caller cannot subscribe products for this workspace

404.description: Workspace or product not found

409.description: Subscription or backing-resource provisioning conflicts with the current state

500.description: Provisioning failed; the response includes a reference ID

post.description:
Invites an existing active Paapeli user by email. OWNER cannot
be granted through an invitation. Workspace authorization
determines whether the caller may invite an ADMIN or a
MEMBER/VIEWER. A previously rejected or expired invitation
may be issued again.

400.description: Invalid role, self-invitation, or invitation state

403.description: The caller cannot invite this role

404.description: No active user exists with the supplied email

post.description: Rejects the authenticated user's pending invitation to the workspace.

403.description: An active user account is required

404.description: No pending invitation exists for this user and workspace

post.description: Accepts the authenticated user's pending invitation to the workspace.

403.description: An active user account is required

404.description: No pending invitation exists for this user and workspace

post.description:
Creates an active Paapeli user and returns an authentication
token. The email is normalized before uniqueness is checked.
Password and confirmedPassword must match, and each password
value may contain at most 72 UTF-8 bytes.

400.description: Validation failed or passwords do not match

409.description: An account with the normalized email already exists

post.description:
Sends an RPC command to a device in the authorized workspace
product and records COMMAND_SENT followed by COMMAND_SUCCEEDED
or COMMAND_FAILED. OPERATE access is required. isOneWay
defaults to true when omitted; queue defaults to false.
deviceName is informational—the server resolves the canonical
device name from its projection.

400.description: Invalid action, device ID, or parameters

403.description: OPERATE access required or the device is outside this workspace product

500.description: The command failed or timed out

get.description: Lists all product definitions available for workspace subscription.

post.description:
Creates a global product definition and its system-managed
ROOT asset type. This is a Paapeli
platform-administrator operation; it does not subscribe a
workspace to the product.

get.description:
Lists the product's complete asset-type catalog, including
the system ROOT type. This endpoint lists definitions; use
the allowed-children endpoint to discover topology rules.

post.description:
Adds an immutable asset-type key to the product catalog.
The label and description may be changed later. ROOT is
system-managed and cannot be created through this endpoint.
Platform-administrator access is required.

409.description: Asset type already exists or ROOT was requested

post.description:
Authenticates an active Paapeli user by email and password.
Email matching is case-insensitive. Use the returned token as
`Authorization: Bearer <token>` on protected endpoints.

get.description:
Returns one page of immediate children. It does not recursively
traverse descendants. Use hasChildren on each result to decide
whether the UI should request another level.

parameters.name: parentAssetId
parameters.description: Paapeli ID of the parent asset

403.description: READ product access required

404.description: Parent asset not found

post.description:
Creates a direct child beneath an active parent. The requested
type must be allowed beneath the parent's type by the product
catalog. That rule is enforced atomically while the local
asset is reserved, before external provisioning begins.

parameters.name: parentAssetId
parameters.description: Paapeli ID of the direct parent asset

403.description: ADMINISTER product access required

404.description: Parent asset not found

409.description: Parent is not active, name conflicts, or the type is not allowed

get.description: Returns the active ROOT node used to start lazy loading the tree.

403.description: READ product access required

404.description: The asset-tree root has not been provisioned

409.description: The root exists but is not active

post.description:
Creates the workspace product's single system ROOT asset.
The product subscription must be active and the caller must
have ADMINISTER access. The ROOT node cannot later be edited
or deleted.

403.description: ADMINISTER product access required

409.description: Root already exists or the workspace product is not ready

get.description:
Returns alarm rules configured for a device in the authorized workspace
product, ordered by creation time descending. Page numbers are one-based.
The requested page size is clamped to the range 1-100. Clear conditions
are intentionally not included in this list representation.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: One-based page number. Values below 1 are treated as 1.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Requested page size. Values are clamped to the range 1-100.

data.name: Sustained high temperature
data.description: Creates a major alarm after five minutes above the threshold

403.description: ADMINISTER product access required or device access denied

post.description:
Creates an alarm rule for a device in the authorized workspace product.
Each create rule is keyed by alarm severity. SIMPLE rules fire as soon as
their expression is true; DURATION rules require a positive duration and
time unit; REPEATING rules require a positive consecutive-event count.
Expressions may combine leaf rules with AND or OR. Literal values must use
the JSON type declared by valueType. An optional clearRule automatically
clears an active alarm when its expression becomes true.

simple.summary: Simple range rule with a clear condition

value.name: High temperature
value.description: Creates a critical alarm while temperature is between 50 and 200

value.name: Sustained high temperature
value.description: Creates a major alarm after five minutes above the threshold

value.name: Repeated overheating
value.description: Creates a warning after three consecutive threshold violations

403.description: ADMINISTER product access required or device access denied

post.description:
Clears an alarm associated with the specified device and records an
ALARM_CLEARED entry in the device activity timeline. The response
contains the alarm's updated state.

parameters.name: alarmId
parameters.description: Alarm ID returned by the alarm list endpoint

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Paapeli device ID associated with the alarm

400.description: Alarm is already cleared or cannot be cleared

403.description: OPERATE product access required, device access denied, or alarm does not belong to the device

404.description: Device or alarm not found

post.description:
Acknowledges an alarm associated with the specified device and records an
ALARM_ACKNOWLEDGED entry in the device activity timeline. Acknowledgement
indicates that an operator has seen the alarm.

parameters.name: alarmId
parameters.description: Alarm ID returned by the alarm list endpoint

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Paapeli device ID associated with the alarm

400.description: Alarm is already acknowledged or cannot be acknowledged

403.description: OPERATE product access required, device access denied, or alarm does not belong to the device

404.description: Device or alarm not found

get.description: Lists INVITED workspace memberships for the authenticated user.

403.description: An active user account is required

get.description:
Returns every available telemetry key for the device over a
recent lookback window. Despite its historical name, the
`from` parameter is a number of hours, not a timestamp. Values
are clamped to the supported range of 1 through 24 hours. Each
series contains at most 100 points in ascending timestamp order.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Lookback window in hours; clamped to 1-24

403.description: READ product access required

404.description: Device not found in this workspace product

get.description: Lists the catalog types that may be created directly beneath the supplied parent type.
Lists all devices in the authorized workspace product, one page at a time.

403.description: READ product access required

get.description: Returns the Paapeli projection of a device in the authorized workspace product.

403.description: READ product access required

404.description: Device not found in this workspace product

delete.description:
Deletes a device that belongs to the authorized workspace
product, removes its local projection, and records a
DEVICE_DELETED activity.

403.description: ADMINISTER product access required

404.description: Device not found in this workspace product

get.summary: List devices assigned to an asset
get.description: Lists devices assigned directly to the supplied Paapeli asset; child assets are not traversed.

403.description: READ product access required

get.description:
Returns the device's Paapeli activity timeline. It includes
gateway lifecycle and command events, plus projected device
connectivity and alarm events such as DEVICE_ACTIVATED,
DEVICE_INACTIVATED, and ALARM_TRIGGERED. Newest activities
are returned first.

403.description: READ product access required

404.description: Device not found in this workspace product

get.summary: List types allowed beneath an asset
get.description:
Resolves the actual parent asset and returns the product types
permitted directly beneath it. This is the preferred endpoint
for populating the type selector in an asset-creation UI.

parameters.name: parentAssetId
parameters.description: Paapeli ID of the parent asset

403.description: READ product access required

404.description: Parent asset not found

get.description:
Returns alarms for a device that belongs to the authorized
workspace product. Alarm creation is also projected into the
device activity timeline as ALARM_TRIGGERED when the alarm
originated from a device.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: One-based page number. Values below 1 are treated as 1.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Requested page size. Values are clamped to the range 1-100.

403.description: READ product access required

404.description: Device not found in this workspace product

delete.description:
Deletes an alarm rule only when both the rule and device belong together
within the authorized workspace product.

parameters.name: alarmRuleId
parameters.description: Alarm rule ID returned by the create or list rule endpoint

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Paapeli device ID that owns the alarm rule

403.description: ADMINISTER product access required, device access denied, or rule does not belong to the device

404.description: Alarm rule not found

PaapeliProductAssetType.description: Asset type definition for a product

productKey.description: Product key this asset type belongs to

assetType.description: Stable asset type key used when creating assets

label.description: Human-readable label for the asset type

description.description: Optional description of the asset type
description.example: Top-level production line under the product root

PaapeliCredentials.description: Device credentials used for device authentication with ThingsBoard

deviceId.description: Device ID these credentials belong to

version.description: Version (server managed; send the current value on update when available)

credentialsId.description:
Credentials identifier.
For ACCESS_TOKEN this is typically the access token string.
For MQTT_BASIC this may be omitted depending on the payload.

credentialsValue.description:
Credentials value.
Required for X509_CERTIFICATE, MQTT_BASIC, and LWM2M_CREDENTIALS.
For MQTT_BASIC this is a JSON string with clientId, userName, and password.
Often null for ACCESS_TOKEN (token is carried in credentialsId).

action.description: Action / method name that the device should execute

params.description: Parameters for the action (can be null or empty)

isOneWay.description: One-way RPC (fire and forget). Default: false

queue.description: Queue the RPC if device is offline. Default: false

isGateway.description: Whether this device acts as a gateway
